how_to_use: Build the position. `wall_prefix_len` says how much of `wall` is real: 136 means the whole wall, so use the full-order constructor; anything shorter is the prefix deal a corpus file stores (wall_source 0), so use the prefix constructor.
Apply each entry of `choices` in order; an entry is [kind_code, payload], with the codes in `choice_kind_codes`.
A reaction window is collected one seat at a time: apply each seat's choice and let the engine choose the next seat itself.
After applying the first N choices, compare: `samples` carries the xxh3-64 digest as 16 hex digits, `canon_samples` the canonical bytes (STATE_CANON.md) as hex.
samples[0] and canon_samples[0] are the opening deal, before any choice is applied.

vectors.description:
The opening deal alone, before any choice: pins the layout of a position in its initial state — full concealed hands, empty rivers and melds, no discard yet.

Note the `choices` script is empty, so every sample is this one position.
vectors.name: fresh_deal

vectors.description: An undirected hand played to its end: discards, reaction windows, claims, and the terminal position.
vectors.name: rotating_full_hand

vectors.description: The same wall, deal and opening script as `rotating_full_hand`, but dealt from a prefix of the wall rather than all 136 tiles — and the prefix stored is the one the *whole* hand draws, so it is more wall than this truncated script needs. Every sample must match `rotating_full_hand` exactly, which is what makes prefix storage safe.
vectors.name: rotating_full_hand_from_wall_prefix

vectors.description: The same wall, deal and opening script as `rotating_full_hand` with `allow_chicken_hands` set. It changes which hands score, so it must move the digest even at a position where no chicken hand can occur.
vectors.name: rotating_full_hand_with_chicken_hands

vectors.description: A hand that melds whenever it can and never declares Hu, so it runs to an exhausted wall. Exercises open chows/pungs/kongs, the meld-exposure log and its call sources, promoted and concealed kongs, and a terminal draw.
vectors.name: meld_heavy_draw
